name: What is a backyard guest house and what are its common uses?

mainEntity.name: What is a backyard guest house and what are its common uses?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backyard guest house, also known as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or granny flat, is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot. It can be attached or detached from the primary home. Common uses include providing independent living space for family members, serving as a rental unit for additional income, or functioning as a dedicated home office, studio, or private retreat. ADUs offer flexible space solutions tailored to various homeowner needs, enhancing property utility without requiring a new land purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: A backyard guest house (ADU) is a secondary housing unit on a residential lot, used for family, rentals, or flexible living space.
